title: Maximum Product Subarray
statement:
Given an array of N integers (which may include negative numbers and zeros), find the contiguous subarray that has the largest product and return that product.

Key insight: maintain both the current maximum and minimum product (since multiplying two negatives gives a positive), and reset on zero.
inputFormat:
Line 1: a single integer N.
Line 2: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: A single integer: the maximum product of any contiguous subarray.

examples.explanation: Zero splits to [-2] and [-1,3,-2]. Best from second part: [3] = 3. Or [-1,3,-2]=6? -1*3=-3, *-2=6. Max = 6. Recalculating: [-1,3,-2] = 6.
